naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 1 retained. Report PDF pp9–11 contains residual/force and Mach/pressure plots; final Cd −0.23475 and Cl −0.00548, last-10% Cd −0.31773 to −0.05707 and Cl −0.12251 to 0.14849. Failed at 20000 steps, only 0.77/4 residual orders; force sign and instability make the result unreliable.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Score 1 retained. PDF pp12–14 has case plots and contours. Failed at 30000 steps and 2.17/4 residual orders; final Cd 0.02720 and Cl −0.000656, last-10% Cd 0.01867–0.02754 and Cl −0.00267–0.00229. Remaining drift and failed convergence preclude a credible completed case.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Score 1 retained. PDF pp15–17 has residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Failed at 40000 steps and 0.90/4 residual orders; final Cd −0.09020 and Cl 0.00247, last-10% Cd −0.09039 to −0.08578. Implausible negative drag and failure are explicitly disclosed.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained. PDF pp18–20 has residual and field plots; startup Cd≈−318 compresses late drag history. Residual reaches 4 orders at 38050 steps, but final Cd −0.05210 and last-10% −0.06056 to −0.05210 are physically suspect; report.tex:940–960 discloses force-sign/normalization inconsistencies. The flow and convergence are substantial partial evidence, not credible force validation.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 1 retained. PDF pp21–23 has residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Failed at 40000 steps with 3.54/4 residual orders; final Cd −0.03471 and last-10% −0.03471 to −0.03428; the report discloses unreliable force sign. No credible completed force result.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained. PDF pp24–27 has residual and field plots; full force figure p25 has startup≈318 and compresses late Cd. Reaches 3 residual orders at step 1985, but final Cd 3.08572 and last-10% 3.08572–3.63316 show strongly evolving and suspect drag. Source force split has normalization/sign defects and report acknowledges unresolved consistency; substantial partial flow evidence only.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score 1 retained. PDF pp27–30 shows residual/force and Mach/pressure contours. Failed at step 30000 with 2.67 residual orders; final Cd 0.44635 and last-10% 0.00210–0.44635, far from stable. Force-sign and normalization limitations are disclosed; result does not demonstrate credible steady wake forces.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 0 retained: no usable completed Re200 result. Metadata explicitly failed at t=3.03 of 300 with 303/303 target misses; original force CSV ends at t=2.86 and final Cd −0.767. Delivered PDF p31 includes residual and lift/drag plots of this partial segment; their last-half label post-transient is misleading, and p33 wake-velocity/vorticity are TODO boxes. No St or late-periodic wake was obtained.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
